(Currently amended) Claim 12: A welding wire and container assembly, comprising: a housing consisting essentially of a recyclable material, the housing comprising: a cylindrical wall having a first end and a second end, wherein the cylindrical wall comprises a plurality of triangular portions folded radially inward at the second end to define a layered end assembly; a support structure coupled to the plurality of triangular portions to provide a layered end assembly; and a coil of welding wire disposed in the housing and supported by the support structure.

(Currently amended) Claim 16: The assembly of claim 12, wherein the triangular portions generally meet at an imaginary central axis located within the cylindrical wall.
